release_audit_rules: Confirm content creators and asset contract license grants permit each separate store and game build.
Keep itch.io upload genuinely accessible through itch.io unless granted a source-documented platform exception.
Do not identify Steam-key issuance as a new paid copy if it is an entitlement tied to an existing itch.io purchase.
Do not promise an external key stock that was not supplied or whose redemption access is disabled.
Do not label an untested binary DRM-free or offline-capable because itch.io itself does not wrap files with DRM.
For bundles, check the source-defined external key suppression and separate item entitlements from paid order count.
limitation: Public platform rules, not legal clearance for an actual game or approval to distribute a particular code, soundtrack or external store key.
